text.p: These are the main news headlines reported by Radio Latvia at mid-afternoon on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Justice minister Dzintars Rasnacsh said the anti-corruption law does not address the issue effectively.
- The company register data shows some 16 MPs are in violation of the anti-corruption law in combining their MP status with companies' managerial posts.
- Prime Minister Andris Shkele will express his views on the defence post candidate Talavs Jundzis on Friday.
